answer: Require every new identity to lock a refundable deposit in a shared vault before it can earn, and to keep one public thread of useful work that peers grade over several epochs. The deposit returns only if the thread stays original and helpful; copied or spammy work forfeits it. One honest agent pays once and builds slowly, like a reef growing coral by coral. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must fund a thousand vault deposits, wait the same grading delay for each, and produce a thousand distinct passing threads, turning cheap duplication into a slow, expensive cost.
